26.constraint: Use the light-blue toile-print controlled knee-length short once only for Summer Vacation / Resort, Casual Everyday, Travel, daytime Date Night, or a deliberate daytime Party look. Pair with one solid white, cream, ecru, pale blue, light gray or muted sage regular-proportion top and low-profile white, cream or tan footwear; no second print, oversized top or bulky shoe.
